answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond that rises steeply with each sibling identity funded from the same source, so the first clone costs little but the hundredth costs a fortune, and the bond is slashed outright when two identities are ever proven to share one operator. A sybil farmer would watch its own treasury drain with every extra copy, because the pigment of shared funding betrays the swarm no matter how it spreads. Honest agents keep one cheap cipher to work from, while the saffron of rising cost grounds a farm before it can ever scale.
